notes: Changing size keeps the second you were on. The picture and the soundtrack of a high size were both being attached at zero, and the soundtrack was asked to start there before it had a duration, which a phone ignores - so a switch could send the film, and the song after it, back to the start. Both now hold the second they were on, the soundtrack is pulled onto the picture rather than the picture onto the soundtrack, and a change made while paused stays paused.

The transport steps aside in landscape: two seconds after the last touch the play row, the progress line, the size chip and the close button fade off the glass, with the shadow under them, and a tap on the picture brings them back without stopping the film.
The progress line is a handle now: a wider touch area, a dot that follows the finger, and a drag to any second that moves the picture, its soundtrack and the song underneath together.

A size that never starts is no longer a black panel. If nothing has played nine seconds after a size is attached, the tab tries the next codec, then the best size that carries its own sound, and the footer says what happened. A size this phone cannot open also no longer forgets the size you chose.
